name: Plex Subtitles Jellyfin
description: 🎬 Plex style subtitle settings for the Jellyfin web player. Click the CC button during playback and change everything live from a Plex-like panel. ★ Tracks: pick the subtitle track and an optional secondary track. ★ Look: colour (9 choices), size (Tiny to Huge), position (Bottom, Raised, Middle, Top) and style (Drop Shadow, Outline, Box, Plain). ★ Timing: subtitle offset in 100 ms and 1 s steps, positive means later, like Plex. ★ Controls aware: bottom subtitles rise above the control bar while it is showing. ★ Per user: each user's choices are saved in their browser, with server-wide defaults on the settings page. ★ Self-contained: no File Transformation or JavaScript Injector needed, and nothing on disk is changed, so it works with read-only web folders (Docker, TrueNAS). ⚠ Note: styles apply to text subtitles (SRT, VTT). ASS/SSA and image subtitles (PGS, VobSub) keep their own look, and burned-in subtitles cannot be restyled.
overview: Plex style subtitle panel for the Jellyfin web player: track, colour, size, position, style and offset from the CC button
